conclusion: Baseline mechanically validates all six outputs and preserves useful high-level demand/status distinctions. It does not establish semantic citation correctness or complete demand coverage: one clear unrelated citation, several fragment/partial citations and a temporal SIGN qualification gap are observed. Most frozen-case detail losses arise at payload/span selection and, for index 12, the 30-row cap; they are not all model interpretation failures. No prompting or implementation fix is prescribed.
